headline: GomSpace Reports Q3 Revenue Growth and Narrows 2026 Guidance
summary: GomSpace reported a 14% EBITDA margin for the third quarter of 2026 and increased order intake by 104%. The company narrowed its full-year 2026 guidance and established long-term financial targets for 2030.
why: GomSpace is a Swedish aerospace company specializing in the design and manufacture of nanosatellites, a growing segment of the space technology industry.

impacts.name: GomSpace
impacts.why: The company reported quarterly financial results and updated its forward-looking guidance.
